acceptanceCriteria: A retained measurement of resume reads and wall time at 20k and 47k receipts, before vs after b30f129de.
A bound is stated in ON-V0-013 or a follow-up is filed.
body: PR #1075 (V1-1650, head b30f129de) made the read resume read one prefix receipt per ticket first posted in the tail by a non-note receipt, for read/writer parity (ON-V0-013). The added I/O was not re-measured at 20k/47k receipts.
title: Measure note-checkpoint resume cost of per-ticket prefix receipt reads (V1-1650 residual)
